data.description: Parts: { key, label, value, color? }. Values of zero or less are left out.

label.description: What the whole is, such as "Visits by source". Names the chart for assistive technology.

unit.description: Unit after values, such as "visits". Shown under the total at rest.

formatValue.description: Formats values in the center, legend, and table.

totalLabel.description: Center label at rest, above the total.

size.description: Diameter in pixels. The chart scales down to fit narrower containers.

groupBelow.description: Parts below this share of the total join Other, when at least two would.

maxSegments.description: The most segments drawn, counting Other. The smallest parts beyond it are grouped.

activeKey.description: Controlled selected segment key. Hover and focus preview other segments without changing it.

defaultActiveKey.description: Selected segment on first render when uncontrolled.

onActiveChange.description: Called when a segment is pinned or unpinned by clicking the ring, or a legend row when legendAction is select.

hiddenKeys.description: Controlled hidden segment keys. A hidden segment closes and the rest of the ring redistributes.

defaultHiddenKeys.description: Hidden segments on first render when uncontrolled.

onHiddenKeysChange.description: Called when a legend row shows or hides its segment.

legendAction.description: What clicking a legend row does: show or hide its segment, or pin it as the selected segment.

legend.description: The synced legend beside or below the ring.

emptyLabel.description: Center text when the total is zero.
